teaser: From a checklist to an app you calibrate: build the smallest version in half an hour, use it tomorrow, log every run, and let it grow.
core_idea: A list of actions with the important ones in bold is already an information system, but it has no history, relies on memory and has a flat interface; instead of designing a final app, build the smallest useful version through an LLM in half an hour, deploy it, use it, keep a small file per run as memory, and calibrate each time so priorities and conditions turn the flat list into a tree; start with no database and nothing confidential so the internet can be the way to share it.
